professionalSummary: Experienced ranking engineer with a proven track record of releasing five ranking models to production, managing on‑call incidents, conducting offline evaluations, and authoring comprehensive model cards.
experienceHighlights: Released five ranking models to the marketplace search service between 2023‑2025, each with a traffic ramp from 1% to full traffic and documented on a release ticket.
Took on‑call duty for ranking incidents, including handling a feature store outage in autumn 2024, with incident records in the search incident log.
Read live relevance and conversion dashboards after every release, rolling back a release in 2024 when a regression was detected.
Evaluated each model offline against held‑out interaction data under an agreed evaluation protocol before release.
Authored model cards for each model, detailing training window, offline and post‑release results, known weaknesses, and hand‑over instructions.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Five release tickets with traffic ramp records
Search incident log record for the feature store outage
Weekly ranking review deck for the last quarter

evidence.text: Released five ranking models to the production search service of the marketplace between 2023 and 2025, each under a traffic ramp from one per cent to full traffic and each on a release ticket in my name.

Read the live relevance and conversion dashboards after every release and in the weekly ranking review, and rolled one release back in 2024 when the conversion dashboard showed a regression on low-traffic categories.
Took on-call duty for ranking incidents throughout that period; the feature store outage of autumn 2024 was mine to handle, and the search incident log carries my incident record for it.

Evaluated every model offline against held-out interaction data under the evaluation protocol agreed with data science before it went to the release review with the search platform team, where the release ticket recorded which checks were mine.

Evaluated every model offline against held-out interaction data under the evaluation protocol agreed with data science before it went to the release review with the search platform team, where the release ticket recorded which checks were mine.
Wrote the model card for each of the five models: training window, offline and post-release results, the known weakness on low-traffic categories, and what the next engineer needed to know.
